name: Youghall Beach
short_description: Youghall Beach park north of Acadie-Bathurst near Gowen Brae and the CCNB Youghall Campus.

summary.en: Youghall Beach park north of Acadie-Bathurst near Gowen Brae and the CCNB Youghall Campus.
summary.fr: Parc de plage Youghall au nord d’Acadie-Bathurst, avec promenade et zone de baignade désignée.
summary.shiac: Youghall Beach park north of Acadie-Bathurst near Gowen Brae and the CCNB Youghall Campus.

contact.hours: Summer operations on the city page: 8:00am to 8:00pm daily, free parking, lifeguards 10:00am to 5:30pm, designated swimming zone, beach sand cleaned daily 7:00am to 10:00am, floating wheelchairs available through East Coast Adventures, no overnight camping, and pets permitted on leash.
